title: Meeting Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Sonny White at a fusion conference

tellings.quote: All I was going to say was uh I was I was uh I was in graduate school doing uh uh pulse icy fusion work when uh I went to a conference to present. I was introduced to Eric Davis, how put off young uh and Sunny White and

plain: While in graduate school working on pulsed fusion, a kind of nuclear energy research, a man named Jack says he went to a conference to present and was introduced to three physicists: Eric Davis, Hal Puthoff and Harold "Sonny" White. Jack tells it himself on a 2025 episode with the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais. He brings it up to explain how he came to know these people.
